meta.name: offensive-network-attacks
meta.description: Dense description covering ARP spoofing, LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS poisoning, DNS poisoning, MITM attacks, VLAN hopping, DHCP attacks, 802.1X/NAC bypass, IPv6 attacks. Tools: Bettercap, Responder, mitm6, Ettercap, Wireshark. MITRE T1557, T1040. Use when conducting internal network assessments or testing Layer 2/3 attack surface.

copy.tagline: 模拟网络攻击,找出内网安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责公司内网安全,想验证是否存在可被利用的攻击路径。
copy.tagline_en: Simulate network attacks to find security holes in your internal network.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage internal network security and want to verify possible attack routes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会指导你在授权内网测试中发起二层/三层网络攻击:利用 ARP、DHCP 等协议的信任缺陷拦截登录凭据、重定向流量、穿越网络边界,并给出 Bettercap、Responder 等工具命令。
howto.when: 当你说要做授权内网渗透评估、测试二层/三层攻击面(如 ARP 欺骗、VLAN 跳跃、DHCP 攻击等)时触发。

say.text: 怎么用 Responder 抓取内网的 NTLMv2 哈希?
say.note: 会给出 Responder 命令及哈希破解示例。

howto.what_en: Claude guides authorized internal pentests of Layers 2/3: exploits trust flaws in ARP/DHCP to intercept credentials, redirect traffic, cross boundaries, with ready commands for Bettercap, Responder, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for an authorized internal network assessment or want to test the Layer 2/3 attack surface (e.g., ARP spoofing, VLAN hopping, DHCP attacks).

say_en.text: Help me ARP-spoof gateway 10.0.0.1 against target 10.0.0.50 using Bettercap.

say_en.text: How do I use Responder to capture NTLMv2 hashes on the internal network?
